rows.author: H030;
rows.title_full: AN ACT ESTABLISHING THE MONTH OF AUGUST AS THE START OF THE ACADEMIC YEAR IN ALL PUBLIC SCHOOLS IN THE PHILIPPINES AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.status: Under deliberation by the Mother Committee on 2014-03-04

committee_action.action: Under deliberation by the Mother Committee on 2014-03-04
committee_action.meethigh:
A.  Deliberation on Measures:


1.	House Bill No. 104 - AN ACT CHANGING THE SCHOOL CALENDAR FROM JUNE TO 	MARCH TO SEPTEMBER TO MAY by Rep. Mercado-Revilla

2.  House Bill No. 2524 - AN ACT REVISING THE SCHOOL CALENDAR FOR THE 	HEALTH, SAFETY AND WELFARE OF SCHOOL CHILDREN AND STUDENT YOUTH, 	AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES by Rep. R. Rodriguez and Rep. M. Rodriguez

3.  	House Bill No. 3413 - AN ACT ESTABLISHING THE MONTH OF AUGUST AS THE 	START OF THE ACADEMIC YEAR IN ALL PUBLIC SCHOOLS IN THE PHILIPPINES 	AND 	FOR OTHER PURPOSES by Rep. O. Garin

4.  House Resolution No. 695 â€“ A RESOLUTION DIRECTING THE COMMITTEE ON HIGHER AND TECHNICAL EDUCATION TO CONDUCT AN INQUIRY, IN AID OF LEGISLATION, ON THE REPORTED PLAN OF HIGHER EDUCATION INSTITUTIONS TO REVISE THE SCHOOL CALENDAR STARTING ACADEMIC YEAR 2014-2015 by Rep. R. Romulo

	a. Major issues/positions and views aired

â€¢	There was not enough time given to students of the University of the Philippines to air their sentiments with regard to the shift of the school calendar because it was held on a Monday, which is a no-class day; the venue where the forum was held could not accommodate the  number of stakeholders who wanted to participate; and the information about the forum was not widely disseminated

â€¢	There should be a transition team composed of the Department of Education (DepEd) , Commission on Higher Education  (CHED) and the Technical Education Skills Development Authority (TESDA)  that would ensure the provision of  technical-vocational, research, training and skills development of students while they await the opening of classes 

â€¢	The Department of Labor and Employment (DOLE) should synchronize their Special Program for Employment of Students (SPES) with the school calendar that will be lengthened from three months to six months

â€¢	The agricultural, farming and fishing community should be consulted as the earnings from their harvests are devoted for the matriculation of their children




â€¢	The school calendar for basic education should be aligned with the higher education institutionsâ€™ (HEIs) for enrolment considerations

â€¢	There should be further and deeper study by the DepEd, CHED, Philippine Atmospheric, Geophysical, and Astronomical Services Administration (PAGASA), Department of Tourism (DOT) , Professional Regulatory Commission (PRC), Department of Health (DOH) and DOLE and broader consultations with other stakeholders

â€¢	There should be a review of the legal history of statutes for any implication on education policies embracing the operations of the basic and tertiary education institutions

â€¢	The measures should provide a specific time frame on the implementation of the proposed school calendar because the budget of education agencies have already been identified for Fiscal Years 2014- 2015 and the budget call for 2015-2016 has commenced

â€¢	The DepEd sees no compelling reason to shift the school calendar from June to March to another period

â€¢	The internationalization aspect for the basic education and higher education levels should be considered separately as HEIsâ€™ tie up with other schools in other countries exists unlike in the basic education

â€¢	The transition and change of school calendar adopted by some HEIs are aligned with the vision of the ASEAN 2015, where the Philippines is a signatory.  Failure of the country to comply could cause the Philippine graduates a problem as they could fall short of qualifications from the set standards that may render them not competitive for employment opportunities in other countries

b. Agreements reached/decisions made:

â€¢	CHED  to submit the list of HEIs with internationalization accreditation and the status report of the Technical Working Group on Academic Calendar 
â€¢	Invite the DOT, DOH, PRC and SEAMEO-INNOTECH in the next joint meeting
â€¢	PAGASA and DepEd to submit their climatological study and research affecting schools, respectively
â€¢	Conduct of a regional consultation for the sentiments of stakeholders throughout the country

rows.author: F100;
rows.title_full: AN ACT DECLARING ANDRES BONIFACIO AS THE NATIONAL HERO
rows.status: Change of committee referral requested on 2014-08-14

committee_action.remarks:
The National Historical Commission of the Philippines submitted their position to the Committee, to wit:  "ON THE ISSUE OF BONIFACIO AS FIRST PRESIDENT, THE BOARD OF THE COMMISSION RECOGNIZES THE REPUBLIC ESTABLISHED IN MALOLOS AS THE FIRST REPUBLIC, WITH A CONSTITUTION DULY APPROVED BY THE MALOLOS CONGRESS, AND EMILIO AGUINALDO AS PRESIDENT.

WHILE THE KATIPUNAN HAS ITS INTERNAL STRUCTURE, LEADERS, AND MEMBERS, IT DID NOT EXIST AS A GOVERNMENT OF A STATE.  WE DO RECOGNIZE THE IMPORTANT ROLE OF ANDRES BONIFACIO IN THE PROCESS OF NATION BUILDING THOUGH NOT NECESSARILY AS THE FIRST PRESIDENT OF THE REPUBLIC.

ANDRES BONIFACIO, IS A NATIONAL HERO, THOUGH NOT THE 'NATIONAL HERO' - AN HONOR THAT BELONGS TO JOSE RIZAL, WHOM BONIFACIO, THE KATIPUNAN AND THE FIRST REPUBLIC REGARDED WITH THE HIGHEST ESTEEM.  NOVEMBER 30 OF THE YEAR IS ALREADY A NATIONAL HOLIDAY IN HONOR OF BONIFACIO AND HIS SACRIFICE FOR OUR PEOPLE. (Sgd.  Dr. Maria Serena I. Diokno, Chairperson)

rows.title_full: AN ACT AMENDING SECTION 32 (B), CHAPTER VI OF THE NATIONAL INTERNAL REVENUE CODE OF THE PHILIPPINES, (R.A. 8424) THEREBY INCREASING THE CEILING OF CHRISTMAS BONUS AND OTHER BENEFITS FROM TAXATION
rows.status: Substituted by HB04970

committee_action.meethigh: The Committee heard the position of the Department of Finance, Bureau of Internal Revenue and National Tax Research Center who strongly objected to the proposed measures because of revenue loss estimated from P10.3B to P43.6B. However all the other guests representing teachers and labor groups and House Members present endorsed the different proposals as the ceiling was never adjusted to reflect the effects of inflation for almost 17 years despite the delegated mandate given to the Secretary of Finance to adjust the ceiling of the 13th month pay/Christmas bonus and other benefits in the computation of the exclusion from gross income. The Committee approved the creation of the technical working group to consolidate the bills.

rows.author: F103;
rows.title_full: AN ACT AMENDING PRESIDENTIAL DECREE NO. 1770 ENTITLED RECONSTITUTING THE NATIONAL GRAINS AUTHORITY TO THE NATIONAL FOOD AUTHORITY AND PROVIDING FUNDS THEREFOR
rows.status: Scheduled for meeting/hearing on 2014-11-24

committee_action.meethigh: The Technical Working Group was created , to be headed by Rep. Agapito Guanlao, to harmonize the bills and discuss related food security issues that need legislation.

As a result of the series of public hearings,particularly in Tuguegarao, Cagayan, General Santos City and Cebu City, the Joint Committee came up with a draft substitute bill which was presented to the Body for further deliberation. Amendments were introduced and the draft was thereby approved with all members present as co-authors. The Secretariat was directed to finalize the bill; send the final draft to the National Food Authority (NFA), Governance Commission for GOCCs (GCC), Department of Budget and Management (DBM), Department of Finance, (DoF), and relevant agencies for their comments and recommendations; and set a clarificatory meeting of the joint panel with the concerned agencies.

Position papers and recommendations from the concerned agencies, particularly the National Food Authority (NFA), Governance Commission for GOCCs (GCGs), Department of Budget and Management (DBM), Department of Finance (DoF) and other relevant agencies, were presented to the Body  for possible amendments to the draft substitute bill.

rows.author: H025;
rows.title_full: AN ACT OFFICIALLY DECLARING DR. JOSE P. RIZAL AND ANDRES C. BONIFACIO AS NATIONAL HEROES OF THE PHILIPPINES
rows.status: Change of committee referral requested on 2014-08-14

committee_action.remarks: The National Historical Commission of the Philippines submitted their position to the Committee, to wit: "ON THE ISSUE OF BONIFACIO AS FIRST PRESIDENT, THE BOARD OF THE COMMISSION RECOGNIZES THE REPUBLIC ESTABLISHED IN MALOLOS AS THE FIRST REPUBLIC, WITH A CONSTITUTION DULY APPROVED BY THE MALOLOS CONGRESS, AND EMILIO AGUINALDO AS PRESIDENT. WHILE THE KATIPUNAN HAS ITS INTERNAL STRUCTURE, LEADERS, AND MEMBERS, IT DID NOT EXIST AS A GOVERNMENT OF A STATE. WE DO RECOGNIZE THE IMPORTANT ROLE OF ANDRES BONIFACIO IN THE PROCESS OF NATION BUILDING THOUGH NOT NECESSARILY AS THE FIRST PRESIDENT OF THE REPUBLIC. ANDRES BONIFACIO, IS A NATIONAL HERO, THOUGH NOT THE 'NATIONAL HERO' - AN HONOR THAT BELONGS TO JOSE RIZAL, WHOM BONIFACIO, THE KATIPUNAN AND THE FIRST REPUBLIC REGARDED WITH THE HIGHEST ESTEEM. NOVEMBER 30 OF THE YEAR IS ALREADY A NATIONAL HOLIDAY IN HONOR OF BONIFACIO AND HIS SACRIFICE FOR OUR PEOPLE. (Sgd. Dr. Maria Serena I. Diokno, Chairperson)
